mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PWD AS userPwd, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickName, EMAIL AS email, USER_PHONE AS userPhone, PHONE_VERIFY_YN AS phoneVerifyYn, SOCIAL_TYPE, DATE_FORMAT(PHONE_VERIFIED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS phoneVerifiedAt FROM USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER SET PHONE_VERIFY_YN = 'N', PHONE_VERIFIED_AT = NULL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PHONE_VERIFICATION ( USER_ID, PHONE, VERIFY_CODE, VERIFIED_YN, EXPIRE_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{phone}, #{verifyCode}, 'N', #{expireAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT VERIFICATION_ID AS verificationId, USER_ID AS userId, PHONE AS phone, VERIFY_CODE AS verifyCode, VERIFIED_YN AS verifiedYn, DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRE_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireAt, DATE_FORMAT(VERIFIED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS verifiedAt, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM PHONE_VERIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PHONE = #{phone} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY VERIFICATION_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE PHONE_VERIFICATION SET VERIFIED_YN = 'Y', VERIFIED_AT = NOW() WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId}
UPDATE USER SET USER_PHONE = #{userPhone}, PHONE_VERIFY_YN = 'Y', PHONE_VERIFIED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER SET USER_PHONE = #{userPhone}, PHONE_VERIFY_YN = 'Y', PHONE_VERIFIED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

UPDATE USER SET USER_PHONE = #{userPhone}, PHONE_VERIFY_YN = 'N', PHONE_VERIFIED_AT = NULL, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{sessionId}
UPDATE USER SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, NICK_NAME = #{nickName}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{sessionId}
